'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Dan Kim LS The Rebel Alliance''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
